name: VerseBlock
title: VerseBlock
summary: A single Bible verse set in Lora with its reference and Share, Copy and Bookmark tools, plus a dark Verse of the Day hero and an inline citation link.
whenToUse: Use `.sx-verse` to feature one verse or a short passage inside a page, article or app screen.
Use `.sx-votd` for the Verse of the Day on the homepage or the dot.Bible app home, on a dark section.
Use `.sx-cite` for a Bible reference inside running text that links to the passage.
whenNotToUse: Do not use VerseBlock for a whole chapter; use ReadingView.
Do not use it for a testimony or a quote from a person; use Quote.

anatomy.description: Verse card: serif verse text, then a footer with the reference on the left and 44px icon tools on the right. Verse of the day (dark): Inline citation: `John 3:3`.

props.name: variant
props.description: `card`: white verse card. `votd`: dark Verse of the day hero with gold accents.

props.name: text
props.description: The verse text exactly as in the translation, without surrounding quotation marks. Never edited or shortened here.

props.name: reference
props.description: Reference such as "John 3:16" or "1 Corinthians 13:4–7", in the reader's language. A non-breaking space is placed after the book name.

props.name: translation
props.description: Translation abbreviation or name ("BSB"). Always name it. Shown after the reference as "John 3:16 · BSB".

props.name: lang
props.description: Language of the verse text and reference (BCP 47), set when it differs from the page language.

props.name: dir
props.description: Reading direction of the verse text. Use "rtl" for Arabic-script and Hebrew translations.

props.name: referenceDir
props.description: Direction of the reference run; references are isolated as LTR by default so digits and punctuation keep their order.

props.name: quoted
props.description: Wrap the text in curly quotation marks. Turn off when the translation supplies its own marks.

props.name: onShare
props.description: Called by the Share tool. The tool is shown only when this is given.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called by the Copy tool. The tool is shown only when this is given. Confirm with a Toast.

props.name: onBookmarkChange
props.description: Called by the Bookmark tool. The tool is shown only when this is given.

props.name: bookmarked
props.description: Whether the verse is bookmarked (`aria-pressed`).

props.name: labels
props.description: Accessible names of the tools.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Eyebrow of the `votd` variant, for example "Verse of the day".

props.name: more
props.description: Lead-in line under a `votd` verse, usually ending in a `VerseCitation`.

props.name: eyebrowId
props.description: Id of the `votd` eyebrow, used as the landmark name; generated when omitted.

props.name: text
props.description: The verse text, exactly as published. Never edited or shortened here.

props.name: reference
props.description: Reference, e.g. "John 3:16".

props.name: translation
props.description: Translation abbreviation or name, e.g. "BSB". Always shown after the reference.

props.name: lang
props.description: BCP-47 language of the verse when it differs from the UI language. Sets line-height and direction.

props.name: quotes
props.description: Wrap the verse in curly quotes.

props.name: onShare
props.description: Show the Share tool when set.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Show the Copy tool when set.

props.name: onBookmark
props.description: Show the Bookmark tool when set.

props.name: bookmarked
props.description: Bookmark is saved.

props.name: labels
props.description: Accessible names for the tools; override for translation.

variantNotes: Tool button (`.sx-ibtn`) states: default, hover (`--gray-100` fill), focus (2px Horizon Blue outline + `--shadow-focus`), saved (`aria-pressed="true"`: `--blue-tint` fill, filled icon). On dark, `.sx-ibtn-dark` is transparent with a white 22% border; saved turns `--leather-gold`. Citation states: default (dotted underline, `--horizon-blue-dim`), hover (solid `--horizon-blue` underline).

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Set verse text in `--font-serif` only: 21px / 1.6 in the card, 34px / 1.4 in Verse of the day (19px and 26px under 768px).
Reference after the verse, sans 600, format "Book chapter:verse · TRANSLATION" (`John 3:16 · BSB`).
Wrap the verse in curly quotes (“ ”). Never italicise the verse.
Tools are `.sx-ibtn` 44px circles, in the order Share, Copy, Bookmark. Three tools at most.
Verse of the day uses gold accents (`.sx-eyebrow-gold`, `.sx-gold-rule`, `--leather-gold` reference), not Horizon Blue. No filled blue button inside it.
A citation that opens the reader on another page ends with ↗; a citation inside the reader that scrolls to a verse has no icon.
do: Use `.sx-verse` to feature one verse or a short passage inside a page, article or app screen.
Use `.sx-votd` for the Verse of the Day on the homepage or the dot.Bible app home, on a dark section.
Use `.sx-cite` for a Bible reference inside running text that links to the passage.
Set verse text in `--font-serif` only: 21px / 1.6 in the card, 34px / 1.4 in Verse of the day (19px and 26px under 768px).
Reference after the verse, sans 600, format "Book chapter:verse · TRANSLATION" (`John 3:16 · BSB`).
Wrap the verse in curly quotes (“ ”). Never italicise the verse.
Tools are `.sx-ibtn` 44px circles, in the order Share, Copy, Bookmark. Three tools at most.
Verse of the day uses gold accents (`.sx-eyebrow-gold`, `.sx-gold-rule`, `--leather-gold` reference), not Horizon Blue. No filled blue button inside it.
A citation that opens the reader on another page ends with ↗; a citation inside the reader that scrolls to a verse has no icon.
dont: Do not use VerseBlock for a whole chapter; use ReadingView.
Do not use it for a testimony or a quote from a person; use Quote.
accessibility: Every icon tool has an `aria-label` ("Share verse", "Copy verse", "Bookmark verse"); icons are `aria-hidden="true"`.
Bookmark is a toggle: `aria-pressed` and swap the label to "Remove bookmark" when saved.
Give Verse of the day a landmark name via `aria-labelledby` pointing at its eyebrow.
Copy and Share confirm with a Toast ("Verse copied"), never only by changing the icon.
Set `lang` on verse text that is not in the page language.
content: Quote the translation exactly; always name it (BSB, KJV, or the local translation).
Short lead-ins only: "Read the whole chapter in the dot.Bible app".
No added commentary inside the verse block. No exclamation marks, no emoji.
